# LOS153 public model-reading fixture

AUTHORED UNRUN. This composes the existing loaded Rails model, save-callback and
explicit source-ownership observers. It adds no capture family or Woods runtime.
Rails is pinned to 8.1.4; the producer uses public SQLite `:memory:` configuration
before Rails' lazy Active Record load. No records are saved and no callback,
condition, job or mail delivery runs. `ReceiptJob` is intentionally uncaptured.

Root must supply a new disposable work directory and an installed candidate
environment, separately admit each finite process, retain stdout/stderr and
native/package identities, and stop dependent work on failure. No server or
runtime execution is authorized by this document. With that admission:

1. Run `produce.rb NEW_WORK_DIR` with `THISTLE_LOS153_INSTALLED=1`; retain its JSON
   as the producer manifest outside the checkout. It saves A, a separately
   identified partial derivative and CURRENT B with a changed source marker.
2. In a fresh installed Rails-free Core+Map process, run `consume.rb MANIFEST`
   with that same opt-in. It checks handwritten cards, raw adapter column values,
   concern/owner/callback boundaries and bounded in-process Rack links. It emits
   the exact saved focus path, IDs, selection and native identity for Root.
3. Use the separately admitted actual served Map and the
   [served protocol](served_protocol.md) with Root's existing nonauthor QA.

Both processes verify package loading under the supplied `GEM_HOME`; they do
not install dependencies or build packages. `test/test_model_reading_installed.rb`
does nothing on ordinary unit-test require and never boots this producer.
The consumer caps source-family traversal at 16 pages per family and Rack link
controls at 12 requests; these are fixture controls, not product throughput or
memory claims. A failed fixture expectation remains a failure to investigate.

The [cards](expected_cards.json) were handwritten against these physical source
files before runtime/UI observations. Read the first question before showing
navigation hints. They are an independent oracle for this public fixture, not
person acceptance or a new comparison campaign. All17 remain unqualified.
